WildSpark 2.2.29 restores the existing minimap profession display without duplicate rows: it recolors the node name using the player's current skill, converts a generic Herbalism/Mining row into one ranked requirement, and scans native WorldCursor tooltips after the UI finishes building them. The minimap overlay is raised above EllesmereUI skin layers.

WildInfo now includes Classic minimum/maximum respawn references for 7,000+ ordinary NPC and rare creature IDs, generated from the CMaNGOS Classic SQLite database. These references are explicitly labeled as Classic and unverified for WoW Forever. Local and peer observations remain separately labeled and take precedence. A monthly GitHub workflow refreshes the table from the current database release.
